text: I had my teeth scaled here. There was no queue when I arrived, so the clinic wasn’t crowded and I didn’t have to wait long. The female doctor was also very nice and friendly.

Couldn’t find my profile, even I have been here for 4times….

Had a dental emergency in BKK.
Filling needed to be re done and tooth chipped.
They couldn't do a same day appt since it was late in the day.
Fit me in 10 am the next day.
Front desk and dentist speaks good English, 40 min later all issues resolved for a great price.
I call that a WIN.

Terrible experience. I went to the dentist because of a toothache. They took an X-ray and then said I needed a tooth extracted. They didn't show me the picture or even tell me which tooth needed to be extracted. I was shocked and asked what I could do if I didn't need it extracted. They said root canal treatment was an option and quoted me the price. When I inquired about a specialist's availability via their Facebook page/LINE, they responded very quickly. However, when I asked for the X-ray I'd already paid for, they didn't reply at all. It was awful. The dentist didn't explain anything, just said I needed to have the tooth extracted. I'm not sure if this is why I received this kind of service – maybe because I'm not Thai. Think carefully before you go to this clinic.

I recently had two teeth extracted and had dentures replaced.
The dentist was very attentive and provided excellent advice. The extraction took place one day and there was no pain or swelling at all. I highly recommend this clinic to everyone.
Good service. They called to make an appointment in advance. The place is clean. The wait time is not too long. The dentist is knowledgeable and skilled.
